_comment: Copy to config.local.json (git-ignored) and fill in. Every field can also come from env vars (ROMARR_HOST, ROMARR_PORT, ROMARR_HTTPS, ROMARR_API_KEY, ROMARR_VERIFY_SSL, ROMARR_TIMEOUT), which override the file. ROMarr's own UI does not display its API key anywhere (despite what its README says) -- pin one by setting ROMARR_API_KEY in the container's environment and restarting; that value then also works to sign into the web UI via 'Use an API key instead'.
